tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /pad tshal gyis zhus 'dod gsol dge/ oṃ swasti/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i mgon du bshes gnyen dam pa'i snang brnyan du shar zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas kun gyi phul dang rnam dkar thugs bskyed mdzad phrin bsil ljongs 'dir 'gran bral du bzhugs pa shar tsong kha pa chen po rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi zhabs pad dri ma med par gtsang pa nam sa yi thig le pad tshal du grags pa'i khyim bzang ga la bar rigs brgyud las 'ongs pa mda' dpon phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / sras tshe dbang rnam rgyal ltos bcas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su gzung du gsol/ pad tshal gyi mi nor kha rje dbang thang sogs legs tshogs thams cad dang / khyad par rigs brgyud dar rgyas yun brtan/ dpa' mdzangs rtul phod mkhas btsun bzang po sogs mdor na srid zhi'i yon tan gyis phyug pa sha stag pas 'phral dang yun du dge legs ma lus 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pas rnam kun dge legs stsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ pad tshal gyis zhus pa'i 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
